creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-07 with the stuck state. pane wait ends refused when its pane goes stuck (unless --until stuck), including a wait started on a pane already stuck, so the only way to see one recover is polling muster window. If a director wants to wait for recovery, --until could take something like 'reading'.
title: A pane wait cannot wait for a stuck pane to recover
